questions.q: Which tag, used in place of <ul>, would number these items?
questions.explain: <ol> is the ordered list: the browser numbers its <li> items for you. <ul> is the unordered list, drawn with bullets; the items inside are <li> in both.
why_wrong: There is no <nl> element in HTML; the numbered list is the ordered list, <ol>.
<dl> is a description list of terms and their definitions, and it is not numbered.
HTML has no <list> element; its lists are <ul>, <ol> and <dl>.
